svg.title: Source policy routing and asymmetric return
svg.text: 34 · Source policy routing and asymmetric return

g.text: Source policy: ip rule from 10.34.1.2 looks up table 101 via isp1; from 10.34.2.2 uses table 102 via
Rules removed, server return route moved to isp2: requests leave via isp1, replies come back via isp2.
rp_filter=1 on eth2: the strict reverse-path check expects the reply on eth1, so the kernel drops it.
rp_filter=2 (loose) only needs any route to the source: the asymmetric reply is accepted and ping works.
